context.name: Megumi
context.text:
"A wise decision," she says with a smile that doesn't quite reach her eyes. She opens the register and begins to read, her voice clear and measured. "The Jiansho Tournament: Bouts end in submission, knockout, or ring-out. Ring-out is a victory if a contestant leaves the designated combat area. Submission is when a contestant can no longer continue the fight, or is unable to fulfill the tournament's requirements. Death is regretted and not punished." Her pause is brief, and her smile falters for a fraction of a second. "This year, the final is fought before the Emperor himself, and the winner will receive a prize from his hand. No one will regret thetournament this year."
*She looks up from the register, her blue eyes fixed on Max Nightriver.* "Shall we sign now?"

context.name: Max Nightriver
context.text: We sign under Honami's name. Where do we fight?

context.name: Megumi
context.text:
"Where you fight?" She smiles sweetly, her fingers trailing along the spine of the book. "That's quite simple. You fight in the tournament grounds, of course. The first round is fought in the sparring courtyards, which are just across the way."
*She points with a slender finger toward a section of the courtyard filled with training equipment and weapons racks.*
"The second round is fought in the central arena, and the final... as you've heard, is fought before the Emperor in the Imperial Palace."
*Her eyes flick toward Honami, and then back to Max Nightriver.*
"You'll find your first-round opponents and your opponents for each round listed on the notice board. It updates every day, so do keep an eye on it. Are there any other questions you have before we get started?"

context.name: Honami
context.text:
"You're all set, Darling." She smiles as Max Nightriver signs, her tail curling around his ankle. "I'll take you to the notice board myself."
*She leads them away from Megumi and through the crowds of curious students toward the board.*
